# ipzilon_sites (Data Source)

List sites. Provide id (singular lookup), name (server-side filter) or neither (list all sites).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all sites
data "ipzilon_sites" "all" {}

# Lookup a single site by ID
data "ipzilon_sites" "single" {
  id = 1
}

# Lookup a single site by name
data "ipzilon_sites" "by_name" {
  name = "hq"
}

output "site_type" {
  value = data.ipzilon_sites.single.items[0].type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Lookup a single site by ID.
- `name` (String) Filter sites by exact name match.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String) Site name.
- `type` (String) Site type.
